title: PEGA DevOps & CI/CD
description: Master enterprise DevOps practices, continuous integration, and continuous deployment for PEGA applications
learning_objectives: Implement comprehensive CI/CD pipelines for PEGA applications
Design automated testing strategies for enterprise PEGA environments
Configure advanced deployment automation with quality gates
Establish DevOps best practices for PEGA development teams

content.text: Enterprise PEGA CI/CD requires sophisticated pipeline architectures that integrate with PEGA's unique development model while providing comprehensive automation, testing, and deployment capabilities. Advanced pipelines handle complex scenarios including multi-application dependencies, environment-specific configurations, and zero-downtime deployments.

# Enterprise PEGA CI/CD Pipeline
name: PEGA-Enterprise-Pipeline

triggers:
  - branch: [develop, release/*, hotfix/*]
  - schedule: "0 2 * * *"  # Nightly builds
  - manual: production-deployment

variables:
  PEGA_URL: '${ENVIRONMENT_PEGA_URL}'
  DATABASE_URL: '${ENVIRONMENT_DB_URL}'
  ARTIFACT_REGISTRY: 'enterprise-pega-artifacts'

stages:
  source_control:
    - name: "Code Checkout"
      actions:
        - checkout_with_submodules
        - validate_branch_naming_convention
        - check_commit_message_standards
    
    - name: "PEGA Rule Extraction"
      actions:
        - connect_to_pega_environment
        - extract_rulesets_with_dependencies
        - validate_ruleset_integrity
        - generate_deployment_package

  quality_assurance:
    parallel_execution: true
    - name: "Static Analysis"
      tools:
        - pega_guardrails_analysis
        - custom_rule_quality_checks
        - security_vulnerability_scan
        - compliance_validation
    
    - name: "Automated Testing"
      test_suites:
        - unit_tests:
            tool: "pega_test_framework"
            coverage_threshold: 85%
        - integration_tests:
            tool: "custom_api_testing"
            environments: ["test", "staging"]
        - performance_tests:
            tool: "jmeter_pega_scripts"
            sla_validation: true
        - security_tests:
            tool: "owasp_security_scanner"
            penetration_testing: automated

  deployment_automation:
    strategy: "environment_promotion"
    environments:
      - name: "development"
        auto_deploy: true
        validation:
          - smoke_tests
          - basic_functionality_check
      
      - name: "test"
        approval_required: false
        validation:
          - comprehensive_test_suite
          - integration_testing
          - performance_baseline_validation
      
      - name: "staging"
        approval_required: true
        approvers: ["tech_lead", "qa_lead"]
        validation:
          - full_regression_testing
          - user_acceptance_testing
          - security_compliance_check
      
      - name: "production"
        approval_required: true
        approvers: ["release_manager", "business_owner"]
        deployment_strategy: "blue_green"
        rollback_capability: "automatic"
        monitoring:
          - real_time_health_checks
          - business_metric_monitoring
          - automated_alert_configuration

  post_deployment:
    - name: "Validation & Monitoring"
      actions:
        - deployment_verification_tests
        - performance_monitoring_setup
        - log_aggregation_configuration
        - dashboard_metric_updates
    
    - name: "Documentation & Reporting"
      actions:
        - generate_deployment_report
        - update_release_documentation
        - notify_stakeholders
        - archive_deployment_artifacts
Comprehensive pipeline architecture ensures reliable, automated deployments while maintaining quality standards and providing full traceability across the deployment lifecycle.

Enterprise PEGA testing requires specialized strategies that account for PEGA's unique architecture, including rule-based logic, case management workflows, and integration patterns. Advanced testing frameworks provide comprehensive coverage while maintaining execution speed and reliability.
Multi-layer testing strategies ensure comprehensive validation of PEGA applications while providing fast feedback cycles and maintaining test reliability across different deployment environments.

Enterprise quality gates go beyond simple pass/fail criteria to implement intelligent decision-making that considers risk factors, business impact, and deployment context. Advanced quality gates provide flexible criteria while maintaining rigorous standards.

hands_on_exercises.title: Enterprise CI/CD Pipeline Implementation
hands_on_exercises.description: Design and implement a complete enterprise CI/CD pipeline for a multi-application PEGA environment
steps: Design comprehensive pipeline architecture with quality gates
Implement automated testing framework with multi-layer coverage
Set up intelligent quality gates with risk-based decision making
Validate pipeline performance through full deployment cycle testing

best_practices: Implement comprehensive automated testing across all layers
Use risk-based quality gates for intelligent deployment decisions
Maintain environment parity through infrastructure as code
Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting throughout pipeline
Establish clear rollback procedures with automated triggers
common_pitfalls: Insufficient test coverage leading to production issues
Overly rigid quality gates blocking necessary deployments
Poor integration between PEGA development and CI/CD tools
Inadequate monitoring leading to undetected deployment problems
